title: mut.disrupt_the_grid
mutation_directive: Disrupted-grid composition (per 2026 design counter-trend against optimized layouts): if the piece has any regular pattern, symmetry, or smooth distribution, deliberately break it in 3-4 specific places — empty zones, density spikes, off-center accents, broken edges. The 'scuffs' should look intentional, not random — like pulled threads in a weave.
